newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB starts Brunel with "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CSFB starts Brunel with "buy".

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston initiated coverage of Brunel International, the Dutch specialist temporary employment firm, with a "buy" rating, the investment bank said on Tuesday.
CSFB said the stock's fair value is 44 guilders, versus its current price of 43.30 guilders, and a 12-month fair value of 50.50 guilders.
Earnings per share for 1997 are estimated at 1.35 guilders and for 1998 at 1.75 guilders, against 0.95 last year, CSFB said.
"The company's business portfolio has strong cash-flow generation and growth potential," analysts at CSFB said in a report, adding Brunel is a "pure play" in the high-end personnel services market.
Brunel shares started trade on the Amsterdam stock exchange on June 19 at a price of 44.20 guilders. The shares were floated at 41 guilders.
